rawServices:
A little update from FauxLocsLondon… 💚

Firstly, thank you.

Thank you for your patience, your love, your recommendations, every booking, every order and every kind message. Your support has meant the world to me, and I’m so grateful for this beautiful community we’ve built together.

✨ Appointments are now open for July – September 2026.

I’ll be taking on a limited number of installation appointments during this period before appointments pause until further notice. If you’ve been waiting for the perfect time to book your next set of locs, this is it!

If you’ve previously sent an email enquiry and didn’t receive a response, I’d be so grateful if you could resend it. Due to unforeseen circumstances I was away from emails for a little while, but I’m now working through enquiries and can’t wait to connect with you again.

📧 Bookings & enquiries:
fauxlocslondon@gmail.com

The good news is that FauxLocsLondon isn’t going anywhere!

You’ll still be able to shop:
🤎 Crochet hair
🤎 Customised wig units
🤎 Ready-to-ship wig units
🤎 Your favourite FauxLocsLondon products

Thank you for your continued love, grace and support. I can’t wait to create with you over the next few months. Let’s make these appointments count! ✨

Love always,
FauxLocsLondon 💚

Wedding season is here! 

These regal and elegant loc styles put a twist to the ‘go to’ looks. 

London & US appointments available now, book via FauxLocsLondon.com

✨ Happy New Year from Faux Locs London ✨

We may have been a little quiet on here, but behind the scenes it’s been a full year of installs, creativity, and beautiful loc journeys. Thank you to every client who booked, returned, referred, and trusted us with their crown throughout 2025 your support truly means everything.

As we step into this new year, we’re excited for what’s ahead and ready to welcome both new and returning clients into the chair.

📅 Bookings are now open for Jan 2026 - with added dates. Secure your appointment and start the year with your hair done and your confidence intact.

Here’s to another year of growth, gratitude, and gorgeous faux locs 🤍

— Faux Locs London 💚✨
#fauxlocs #locs #fauxlocslondon #hairstyles #reels

GettingMyHairDoneaHolic 💁🏾‍♀️

There’s something about having your hair done that goes beyond the aesthetic. It’s the feeling of showing up for yourself. It’s the confidence returning. It’s the reminder that you deserve to feel good, looked after.

Faux locs are not just a style. They’re a reset. A moment to breathe.
A reminder that your softness, your beauty, and your well-being matter.

When your crown is cared for, you feel cared for. And you deserve that every season 💚

GET THE LOOK:
STYLE: Soft locs
LENGTH: Bra strap
